observations: Static tick/numeral green matches span both sides of face.
Reference-axis cyan line follows printed top/bottom orientation; G examples visibly rotate clockwise relative to D002.
Needle/counterweight sectors, hub and background are excluded from descriptor support.

training_only_recommendation.why: The actual training frames already contain relative print rotations from -5.66 to +9.42deg; ±8 perturbation is applied around each original image pose, not a hard absolute pose acceptance gate.

critical_dependency_note: Direct visual hub/thin-terminal labels are used only offline to EXCLUDE dynamic needle/counterweight features in this audit. They are not CNN inputs, not a production pose estimator requirement, and not a prerequisite for starting CNN.
limitations: Only78train/37validation prints had sufficient masked registration evidence; unknown samples have no assigned roll.
Relative apparent in-plane print rotation is not calibrated absolute upright, physical yaw or pitch.
Local homography rotation can be confounded by perspective; anisotropy metadata retained.
Existing model direction error is measured relative to each image own annotated direction; it cannot be explained away simply by image roll.
